result.evidence:
I verified at v2/s9 b3a1469 with a detached HEAD, no edits and no commits. master is an ancestor of the branch. The 13 local-only verification scripts are in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-workingmyassof-satbank/9030c288-6222-49fa-a25a-6e6802e22cd3/scratchpad/s9v/ (the main ones are walk.py, interact.py and follow*.py). The server ran on :8029 with SATF_DB=<worktree>/server/v2.db and is now stopped.

1. Checks. `PYTHONPATH=. python3 server/checks/s9.py` passed all 13 groups and printed "S9 server checks passed". `PYTHONPATH=. python3 server/test_flow.py` exited 0 and printed "all good".

2. Page walk. I opened 15 URLs at 1280 and 390 (the 390 contexts had touch), for a new learner and for a seeded one (a:v2revwords01: 24 grades, 6 saved, 2 own words, one cards run and one quiz run). The URLs were /words/ (with ?w=, ?c=transitions, ?c=roots, ?m=1 and ?d=hardforyou), /words/study/ (cards and quiz), /words/mine/ (with ?view=wall), /words/run/ (with and without ?id), /words/print/ and /vocabulary/.
- No console errors, no page errors, and scrollWidth never went past the viewport.
- The only 4xx was the expected 403 when the new learner opened the other learner's run. The page shows "This run belongs to someone else."
- /vocabulary/ redirects to /words/, and every page answers 200.

Acceptance items that passed:
- 26: 6 grid columns at 1280; the strip has 4 tiles; collection groups READING & WRITING, ROOTS and MINE with a count on every tile; the filter bar has Collection, Topic, Difficulty, Status, Part of speech and Sort.
- 27: Meanings adds m=1 and puts a meaning on every visible tile.
- 28: at 390, width 390, 2 columns, and the study bar sits above the 5-tab bar.
- 29 (amended by §2.13): Q on /words/ opens the quick sheet with an Add a word tab; there is none on /words/run/.
- 31, using mitigate (decision 2 has no math words): MEANING, IN AN SAT-STYLE QUESTION, NOT THE SAME AS and YOUR RECORD; 4 options; no /api/words/run or /api/drill request; Esc closes and drops ?w.
- 32: Flashcards from here opens the word front-first.
- 33: Space flips the card (back aria-hidden=false); 2 shows "Know · Back in 2 days"; ← shows the previous card and its grade; → sends answer "skip".
- 34: the 15 s timer shows "Out of time".
- 35, on a Words page: the .term is a button; one POST to lookup; the pop shows the meaning; Esc returns focus; no .term inside .opts.
- 39: the speak button is hidden with no voices, and each click calls speak once.
- 40: with reduced motion, every card face has transform none.

Items 36-38 are on other sections' pages.

3. Sample of 15 requirements:
1. §1 tabs, with short labels under 420px: pass.
2. §1 N opens the Add sheet: pass.
3. §1 Add a selection (UI.addWordFromSelection): fail, it is not built.
4. §3 Meanings: pass.
5. §8 study bar follows the filter ("8 words · 8 due" with ?s=due): pass.
6. §11 gloss: pass in the library, fail in a word→meaning quiz (it shows the answer).
7. W1.7 SAT-style sample (4 reasons and a .clue): pass.
8. W2.4 9 .logic-col with a test line: pass.
9. W3.3 shades strip with one aria-current: pass.
10. W5.4 "family known" on all 119 root tiles: pass.
11. W8.4 Type it hint: fail.
12. W11.5/6 Today's words panel on /words/, study and mine (not on run), with Review cards, Learn 10 and Quiz: pass.
13. W13.2 wall: 1,326 .wcell, each with an aria-label: pass.
14. W14.1/3 covered sheet: Space uncovers, 2 sends exactly one grade POST, ?q= opens uncovered: pass.
15. W19.3 From a text marks exactly mitigate and ubiquitous with no request: pass.

Beyond the sample:
- W22.2: offline cards advance ("Saved on this device", "Offline · 1 grade will sync") and the queued answer POSTs on reconnect: pass.
- W20: the print sheet renders: pass.
- Right answers stay 5 s at 390 with touch: pass.

4. Scope and decisions. `git diff --stat master...HEAD` touches only the 8 files the task owns: web/words/** (including sw.js), web/vocabulary/index.html and web/assets/words-ui.js. Grepping web/words, web/vocabulary and words-ui.js for teacher, assignment, homework, /class/ and /join/ finds nothing. There is no math deck, and there are no accent colors outside the print sheet's black-and-white ink.

defects.what: Answer leak. In a word→meaning quiz the question text is the target word itself, and UI.gloss turns it into a tappable .term. Its popover shows the correct option word for word: the stem 'mitigate' popped 'make a harm or risk less severe', which is option C. It also files a lookup.
defects.fix: Do not gloss the question text when it is the target word (item.kind word2meaning, or any kind whose question text is item.text), or add the target word to exclude. Keep the rule that choices are excluded.

defects.what: UI.addWordFromSelection(root) is missing. It is in the §2.10 registry and the §2.9 contract (S4, S3, S6 and S8 use it), and the section spec §1 'Add a selection' plus acceptance #30 need it. grep finds no definition anywhere in web/.
defects.fix: Add UI.addWordFromSelection(root). When 1-6 words are selected inside root, show UI.pop at the selection rect with an 'Add to my words' button that calls UI.addWord({word: selection, source}). It never appears in the test window. Export it next to addWord.

defects.what: The offline entry point is broken. UI.todayWords is only mounted after GET /api/words succeeds. After 'Take today's cards offline' (toast: '12 cards on this device · they work with no signal'), opening /words/ offline shows only 'Words did not load. Retry'. The panel's own offline branch ('Offline cards · N left' in words-ui.js:279) never runs, so the stored cards can only be reached if the run URL is already open.
defects.fix: Mount UI.todayWords($('today')) before the library fetch or apart from it (at least in the load() catch), so its offline branch can show the stored run.

defects.where: server words public item for 'typed' (not S9-page-owned); web/words/run/index.html:763
defects.what: W8.4: the typed public item has no 'first' field (it has kind, stem, text, choices and item_id only), so 'Hint · first letter' is always disabled ('No hint for this one') and Alt+W does nothing.
defects.fix: The server owner adds 'first' (the key's first letter) to typed public items, or adds a hint endpoint. The page already reads item.first.

defects.what: On the live server, POST /api/words/run/{id}/another {like:'word'} after answering an in-context item always returned 409 'this twin was already added; request another' (8 of 8, right and wrong answers). So T in a quiz verdict and the sheet's Twin button only show a toast.
defects.fix: Server: make words.another respect 'seen', or pick the next unseen template, before the duplicate guard.

defects.what: T is offered for items with no generated twin (meaning2word). It POSTs /another, gets a 409 (a console 'Failed to load resource' error) and toasts 'This item has no generated twin'.
defects.fix: Only bind or show T / Another when the item kind is generated (incontext or transition).

defects.where: server run builder (server owner); web/words/study/index.html default quiz
defects.what: A new learner's default Quiz Start ({deck:{source:'new'}, formats:['meaning2word','incontext'], count:10}) returns 409 'no reviewed frame is available for this word'. The first new word, 'account', has no reviewed frame. The page shows the toast and does not start.
defects.fix: Server: skip or fall back for words with no reviewed frame when building incontext items. Page option: retry without incontext on that 409.

defects.what: POST /api/words/run {mode:'check'} returns 409 'not enough reviewed items for a Words check' with the live content, so the Words check cannot start. I could not check W16.3 (no .term before finish) on a live check run.
defects.fix: Review more frames, or relax the gate, on the server/content side.
